description: Convert a flat 2D floorplan image into a downloadable GLB 3D model. Costs 100 MeltFlex credits. The .glb is downloaded to disk and the file path is returned. Best results come from a clean, high-contrast floorplan with clear walls.

image.description: Source 2D floorplan image (JPEG, PNG or WebP): a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image/...;base64,... URL.

output_path.description: Where to save the .glb. Defaults to ./meltflex-output/model-<timestamp>.glb in the current working directory.

name: floorplan_to_3d
title: Convert floorplan to 3D model
